integrity: Complete analytic proof plus reproducible exact-rational sample verification; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a deterministic three-species construction with a conserved product and a specified five-function per-capita dictionary. The exact rank claims assume full-state noiseless continuously differentiable observations, nonstationarity of two coordinates and noninteger growth-to-relaxation ratios. No generic ecological identifiability, noisy-data stability, or mechanistic causal certification is claimed.
title: Exact one-trajectory camouflage and two-trajectory identification of a hard ecological interaction
